Stated purpose: strengthened shareholder returns as part of capital-cost and stock-price-focused management; secondary uses include M&A consideration and restricted-stock compensation.
title_en: Notice of Decisions Regarding Matters Related to Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief: On 31 August 2026, the board of People, Dreams & Technologies Group Co., Ltd. (ticker 9248, TSE Standard) resolved to authorize treasury stock acquisition under Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied to Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 200,000 ordinary shares (2.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥300 million via open-market purchase through broker commission trading between 1 October 2026 and 30 April 2027. The stated rationale is to strengthen shareholder returns as part of management's capital-cost and stock-price-conscious strategy; the company also intends to use acquired shares for M&A consideration and restricted-stock compensation. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 503,381 treasury shares (including shares held by J-ESOP and E-SHIP trusts) against 8,912,619 shares outstanding excluding treasury.
